review_comment: The code directly assigns unvalidated user input from URL path parameters to context without authorization verification. This allows potential unauthorized access to user devices if the devices_for_user method does not enforce ownership validation. The patch introduces an unvalidated assignment that bypasses proper authorization checks. Ensure that all user_id values are validated against the authenticated user before accessing user-specific data.
